resources.string: Show your phone, Samsung DeX or any Miracast screen on this TV
Press Start to wait for your phone
On your phone: open Quick settings, tap Samsung DeX (or Smart View), then pick this TV.
Getting 5 GHz ready for 2560x1440 (about a minute)…
For 5 GHz and 2560x1440, turn on USB debugging in the TV’s developer options
On the TV, allow USB debugging and tick “Always allow”
Standard mode, 1080p. 5 GHz gives 2560x1440 but needs USB debugging on the TV.
How to use Wireless Display Receiver
Swipe down for Quick settings and tap Samsung DeX (or Smart View).
Choose the TV with the name shown on this app’s screen. Accept the prompt if the phone asks.
The picture takes the whole TV. Press Back on the remote to end it.
Mouse pointer: on the phone, tap the “Samsung DeX is running” notification to open the touchpad.
1 USB debugging on · 2 “Allow” once · 3 Wi-Fi restarts

This TV has no Wi-Fi country code, so Wi-Fi Direct is limited to 2.4 GHz and the phone sends 1080p. With the country set, Wi-Fi Direct can use 5 GHz and the phone sends 2560×1440, a much sharper picture.

It signs in to this TV’s own adb (USB debugging must be on, and the TV asks “Allow” once), sets the Wi-Fi country from the TV’s language and restarts the Wi-Fi. That takes about a minute after each TV restart.
Nothing permanent changes on the TV. The mode switches itself off when you stop or leave the app, and the key the app signs in with is deleted.
Location permission is needed to find your phone.
This TV has no Wi-Fi Direct
